Function CreateLayerStructure(LayerType As String) As Object
Const LAYER_A_BASE_PICK = 340 Const LAYER_B_BASE_PICK = 540 Const LAYER_A_BASE_DEP = 400 Const LAYER_B_BASE_DEP = 600
Dim layerStructure As Object: Set layerStructure = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Dim LayerComposition As Object: Set LayerComposition = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
Dim boxes As Collection: Set boxes = New Collection
Dim TG_Layer As TagGroup: Set TG_Layer = Application.CreateTagGroup(Me.AreaName)
Dim baseRegisterPick As Integer Dim baseRegisterDep As Integer Dim i As Integer Dim box As Object
TG_Layer.Active = False
Select Case LayerType Case "LayerA" baseRegisterPick = LAYER_A_BASE_PICK baseRegisterDep = LAYER_A_BASE_DEP Case "LayerB" baseRegisterPick = LAYER_B_BASE_PICK baseRegisterDep = LAYER_B_BASE_DEP Case Else Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage "LayerType non valido: " & LayerType Exit Function End Select
LayerComposition("LayerType") = LayerType LayerComposition("NBoxA") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R110": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("NBoxA") LayerComposition("NBoxB") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R111": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("NBoxB") LayerComposition("PalletX") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R107": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("PalletX") LayerComposition("PalletY") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R108": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("PalletY") LayerComposition("NBoxX") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.NumberBoxIn_X": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("NBoxX") LayerComposition("NBoxY") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.NumberBoxIn_Y": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("NBoxY") LayerComposition("OffsetDepositX") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R100": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("OffsetDepositX") LayerComposition("OffsetDepositY") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R101": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("OffsetDepositY") LayerComposition("PickType") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R106": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("PickType") LayerComposition("CaseX") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R124": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("CaseX") LayerComposition("CaseY") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R125": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("CaseY") LayerComposition("PickingWheel") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R123": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("PickingWheel") LayerComposition("NBoxCHA") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R134": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("NBoxCHA") LayerComposition("NBoxCHB") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R135": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("NBoxCHB") LayerComposition("ApproachX") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R103": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("ApproachX") LayerComposition("ApproachY") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.Generals.R104": TG_Layer.Add LayerComposition("ApproachY")
For i = 1 To 60 Set box = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") box("id") = i box("PositionX") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer." & LayerType & ".X" & LayerType & "Pos" & i box("PositionY") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer." & LayerType & ".Y" & LayerType & "Pos" & i box("PositionR") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer." & LayerType & ".W" & LayerType & "Pos" & i box("PickType") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.PickUpType_x_Deposit" & LayerType & ".R" & (baseRegisterPick + i - 1) box("DepositType") = "/FTDS_Area::[clogix]PAL_SizeDisplayed.Palletizer.DepositType" & LayerType & ".R" & (baseRegisterDep + i - 1) TG_Layer.Add box("PositionX") TG_Layer.Add box("PositionY") TG_Layer.Add box("PositionR") TG_Layer.Add box("PickType") TG_Layer.Add box("DepositType") boxes.Add box Next i
Set LayerComposition("boxes") = boxes
TG_Layer.Active = True
Set layerStructure("LayerComposition") = LayerComposition Set layerStructure("LayerCompositionTG") = TG_Layer
Set CreateLayerStructure = layerStructure
End Function
Function ToJSON(value As Variant) As String
Dim result As String Dim key As Variant Dim i As Long
Select Case TypeName(value) Case "Dictionary" result = "{" For Each key In value.Keys result = result & """" & key & """:" & ToJSON(value(key)) & "," Next If Right(result, 1) = "," Then result = Left(result, Len(result) - 1) result = result & "}" Case "Collection" result = "[" For i = 1 To value.Count result = result & ToJSON(value(i)) & "," Next If Right(result, 1) = "," Then result = Left(result, Len(result) - 1) result = result & "]" Case "String" result = """" & Replace(value, """", "\""") & """" Case "Boolean" result = LCase(CStr(value)) Case Else If IsNull(value) Then result = "null" Else result = CStr(value) End If End Select ToJSON = result
End Function
Function BuildPalletValues(ByVal layerStructure As Object, LayerType As String) As Object
Dim palletValues As Object: Set palletValues = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Dim layerComp As Object: Set layerComp = layerStructure("LayerComposition") Dim tg As TagGroup: Set tg = layerStructure("LayerCompositionTG") Dim key As Variant Dim i As Long Dim box As Object Dim bRetVal As Boolean Dim slTagsInError As StringList Dim sErrorMsg As String Dim sRoutineName As String: sRoutineName = "PALCOMPOSE"
bRetVal = tg.RefreshFromSource(slTagsInError) If bRetVal And slTagsInError.Count = 0 Then Dim Nbox As Integer If LayerType = "LayerA" Then Nbox = tg.Item(layerComp("NBoxA")).value Else Nbox = tg.Item(layerComp("NBoxB")).value End If For Each key In layerComp.Keys ' --- BOXES --- If TypeName(layerComp(key)) = "Collection" Then Dim boxesValues As Collection: Set boxesValues = New Collection For i = 1 To Nbox Set box = layerComp(key)(i) Dim boxVal As Object: Set boxVal = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") boxVal("id") = box("id") boxVal("PositionX") = tg.Item(box("PositionX")).value boxVal("PositionY") = tg.Item(box("PositionY")).value boxVal("PositionR") = tg.Item(box("PositionR")).value boxVal("DepositType") = tg.Item(box("DepositType")).value boxesValues.Add boxVal Next i Set palletValues("boxes") = boxesValues ' --- TAG SINGOLI --- Else Dim tagPath As String Dim tagItem As Object If StrComp(key, "LayerType", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then palletValues(key) = layerComp(key) Else tagPath = layerComp(key) On Error Resume Next Set tagItem = tg.Item(tagPath) On Error GoTo 0 If Not tagItem Is Nothing Then palletValues(key) = tagItem.value Else Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage "Tag non trovato: " & key & " -> " & tagPath End If End If End If
Next key Set BuildPalletValues = palletValues
Else 'Print and record system messages If slTagsInError.Count > 0 Then For i = 1 To slTagsInError.Count If i > 1 Then sErrorMsg = sErrorMsg & ", " & slTagsInError.Item(i) Else sErrorMsg = "Routine: " & sRoutineName & " - 1011." & vbCrLf & "Error Occurred: Variable: " & slTagsInError.Item(i) End If Next sErrorMsg = sErrorMsg & " not correctly updated in tagGroup G_tgHMIConfigurationVariables" Else sErrorMsg = "Routine: " & sRoutineName & " - 1012." & vbCrLf & "Error Occurred: Problem in updating the tagGroup G_tgHMIConfigurationVariables" End If 'Print inside the diagnostics buffer the problem that is occured. If sErrorMsg <> "" Then Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage Replace(sErrorMsg, vbCrLf, " "), ftDiagSeverityError End If End If End Function
Private Sub Display_AnimationStart()
' --- Dichiarazioni --- Dim collLodedDisplayList As Displays Dim oBackgroundDisplay As Object Dim iRetVal As Integer Dim xLayerType As Boolean Dim sErrorCode As String Dim gLayerComposition As Object Dim gLayerCompositionA As Object Dim gLayerCompositionB As Object Dim runtimeValuesLayer As Object Dim jsonData As String Dim LayerType As String
' --- Percorsi file e URL definiti all'inizio --- Dim filePathJS As String: filePathJS = "C:\Users\IMA-1\Documents\IMA\PalCompose\RuntimeLayerData.js" Dim filePathCSV As String: filePathCSV = "C:\Users\IMA-1\Downloads\RuntimeData.csv" Dim browserURL As String: browserURL = "file:///C:/Users/IMA-1/Documents/IMA/PalCompose/Index.html"
' --- Oggetti FileSystem --- Dim fso As Object Dim file As Object
' --- Variabili CSV --- Dim firstLine As String Dim firstFields Dim isSaved As Boolean
' --- Layer e Tag --- Dim layerAComp As Object Dim layerBComp As Object Dim tgA As TagGroup Dim tgB As TagGroup
Dim line As String Dim fields Dim idxA As Long Dim idxB As Long Dim tagPath As String Dim tagItem As Object Dim boxA As Object Dim boxB As Object
' --- Altri --- Dim ctrl As Object Dim i As Integer
isSaved = False
' --- Recupero display background --- Set collLodedDisplayList = LoadedDisplays For i = 1 To collLodedDisplayList.Count If collLodedDisplayList.Item(i).Name = "000 - VBA_code" Then Set oBackgroundDisplay = collLodedDisplayList.Item(i) Exit For End If Next i
If oBackgroundDisplay Is Nothing Then Set oBackgroundDisplay = Application.ShowDisplay(oElement.Name, "/ZA") End If
' --- Creazione strutture layer --- Set gLayerCompositionA = CreateLayerStructure("LayerA") Set gLayerCompositionB = CreateLayerStructure("LayerB")
iRetVal = oBackgroundDisplay.ReadTag_Any("{Internal_tag\PalCompose\L_St_xLayerType}", xLayerType, sErrorCode)
If (iRetVal = 4) And (xLayerType <> 0) Then Set gLayerComposition = gLayerCompositionA LayerType = "LayerA" Else Set gLayerComposition = gLayerCompositionB LayerType = "LayerB" End If
' --- Generazione JSON --- Set runtimeValuesLayer = BuildPalletValues(gLayerComposition, LayerType) jsonData = ToJSON(runtimeValuesLayer)
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
' --- Scrittura file JS --- Set file = fso.CreateTextFile(filePathJS, True, False) file.WriteLine "const palletData = " & jsonData & ";" file.Close
Set ctrl = Me.Application.ActiveDisplay.FindElement("SEWebBrowserControl1") ctrl.url = browserURL
Do While Dir(filePathCSV) = "" DoEvents WaitMs 1000 Loop
' --- Lettura CSV --- Set file = fso.OpenTextFile(filePathCSV, 1) If Not file.AtEndOfStream Then firstLine = file.ReadLine firstFields = Split(firstLine, ",") If UBound(firstFields) >= 1 Then If UCase(Trim(firstFields(1))) = "TRUE" Then isSaved = True End If End If
If isSaved Then Set layerAComp = gLayerCompositionA("LayerComposition") Set layerBComp = gLayerCompositionB("LayerComposition") Set tgA = gLayerCompositionA("LayerCompositionTG") Set tgB = gLayerCompositionB("LayerCompositionTG")
If Not file.AtEndOfStream Then file.ReadLine
Do While Not file.AtEndOfStream line = file.ReadLine fields = Split(line, ",")
Select Case fields(0) Case "CommonVariable" tagPath = layerAComp(fields(1)) Set tagItem = tgA.Item(tagPath) If Not tagItem Is Nothing Then tagItem.value = fields(2) Else Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage "Tag non trovato CommonVariable: " & fields(1) End If
Case "LayerA" idxA = CLng(fields(1)) If idxA >= 1 And idxA <= layerAComp("boxes").Count Then Set boxA = layerAComp("boxes")(idxA) tgA.Item(boxA("PositionX")).value = CDbl(fields(2)) tgA.Item(boxA("PositionY")).value = CDbl(fields(3)) tgA.Item(boxA("PositionR")).value = CDbl(fields(4)) tgA.Item(boxA("PickType")).value = fields(5) tgA.Item(boxA("DepositType")).value = fields(6) End If
Case "LayerB" idxB = CLng(fields(1)) If idxB >= 1 And idxB <= layerBComp("boxes").Count Then Set boxB = layerBComp("boxes")(idxB) tgB.Item(boxB("PositionX")).value = CDbl(fields(2)) tgB.Item(boxB("PositionY")).value = CDbl(fields(3)) tgB.Item(boxB("PositionR")).value = CDbl(fields(4)) tgB.Item(boxB("PickType")).value = fields(5) tgB.Item(boxB("DepositType")).value = fields(6) End If End Select Loop
Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage "File valido: Saved = TRUE"
Else Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage "File valido: Saved = FALSE" End If
file.Close
If fso.FileExists(filePathCSV) Then fso.DeleteFile filePathCSV, True End If
If (iRetVal = 4) And (xLayerType <> 0) Then Application.ExecuteCommand "Display 281 - SizeData_Layer_TypeA_1" Else Application.ExecuteCommand "Display 291 - SizeData_Layer_TypeB_1" End If
Set collLodedDisplayList = Nothing Set oBackgroundDisplay = Nothing
End Sub

' ====== Custom wait function with DoEvents ====== Public Sub WaitMs(ByVal I_dTimeToWait As Double) Dim ElapsedTime, Timer0 Timer0 = Timer Do ElapsedTime = Timer - Timer0 If ElapsedTime < 0 Then ElapsedTime = ElapsedTime + 86400 End If DoEvents Loop Until ElapsedTime >= I_dTimeToWait / 1000 End Sub
